shape-1 BAR (written 2026-10-03 before any box run). Question: does the CIS-2 C driver (verify3 sv5_driver, built with the spec flags), written and pinned for SmolLM2 shapes, run a Llama shape it was never pinned on and give identical digests on four CPU classes? Model: JackFram/llama-160m converted to bf16 (model.safetensors sha256 261167a02cc8283b0a081b707ccabbf6ad8738d83bfe1b149d0b86d11391cfc4; Llama architecture, hidden 768, 12 layers, 12 attention heads with 12 KV heads, untied lm_head, vocab 32000; config.json gets rope_theta 10000.0 written explicitly because the checkpoint config omits it and the C driver would default to 100000). Prompts: the first 100 sv-5 TEST prompts re-tokenised from their text with the llama tokenizer, BOS included, cut at 64 tokens (prompts.jsonl sha256 c968400609ddb1b3015d277aafc893d925f7c15d9e4e724be8f7986ec015b0d0); 32 greedy tokens; one run per prompt. Hosts: penguin (AVX2), box3 (Celeron N4020C, no AVX2), box4 (Sempron SI-42, SSE3 only), box5 (Pentium T2310, SSSE3 only).
(a) MET only if all four hosts give identical ids_out, witness digest and argmax digest on 100 of 100 prompts. Any differing prompt on any host = not met.
(b) own verdict: MET only if the C driver's 32 tokens equal the 32 tokens of stock PyTorch 2.10 fp32 greedy decoding on the bf16-widened weights (1 thread, KV cache, penguin) on at least 95 of 100 prompts (whole 32-token string equal).
Prediction written before the run: (a) yes; (b) 97 to 100 of 100 (10 of 10 on a 10-prompt penguin smoke test). Reported without a bar: first differing position and count for any prompt where C and torch disagree, seconds per prompt per host. Scope: one additional shape, one prompt set, 32 tokens; says nothing about larger models, other tokenizers' edge cases, or throughput. Negative outcomes are reported as negative.
title: CIS-2 C driver on a new Llama shape (llama-160m, MHA, untied head): digests on four CPU classes and agreement with stock torch
